learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to combine our playtime games with dancing moves in one exciting artwork!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Dancing with toys is the best! We can draw our figures holding a ball, a skipping rope, or colorful ribbons that twirl in the air.
Where are you playing? We can draw a background with green grass, a bright yellow sun, and some friendly trees to complete our picture.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Skipping Rope Dance
fun_activity.instructions: Draw yourself jumping rope! Make the rope a big wavy line over your head, and draw your feet lifted off the ground.

quick_recap: ⭐ Adding objects like a ball or a ribbon makes a dancing picture more active.
⭐ Drawing a background helps tell a story about where the fun is happening.
⭐ Playing and dancing bring out the most wonderful creative ideas!
